decisive_items: concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells present around small vessels
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels
Smooth muscle actin (SMA) was diffusely positive in the tumor cells
response.rationale: The presence of tumor cells around small vessels, positive CD31 immunostain, and smooth muscle actin positivity support the diagnosis of Angiosarcoma, which is a vascular tumor.

rejected.why: Histopathology findings do not support Squamous cell carcinoma diagnosis
Negative staining for Kaposi sarcoma-associated herpesvirus contradicts Kaposi sarcoma diagnosis
